mapper.select: SELECT settings_json::text FROM project_subtitle_settings WHERE project_id = #{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_subtitle_settings (project_id, settings_json) VALUES (#{projectId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, CAST(#{settingsJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO UPDATE SET settings_json = EXCLUDED.settings_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
